Author: V.G.Arun

 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice V.G.Arun
 Thursday, the 22nd day of December 2022 / 1st Pousha, 1944
 Wp(C) No. 11725 Of 2020
 Petitioner:
 Tom Jacob, Managing Partner, Kayyalakam Oil Company,
 Cheeranchira.P.O, Changanacherry, Kottayam-686106.

entities.text: High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondents:
 1. State Of Kerala, Represented By The Secretary To Government,Health
 Services Department, Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram-695001.
 And 2 Others

Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to issue an interim order allowing the petitioner to continue the
 manufacture and marketing the two brands of coconut oil namely Hrudayam
 and Nalla which are already registered with Food Safety and Standards Act
 as evident from Exhibit P-5 license issued, notwithstanding Exhibit P-16
 order, pending decision of the above Wp(C).
 This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition
 and the affidavit filed in support of Wp(C) and this Court's order dated
 20.12.2022 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S T.V.Ajayakumar and Rimju
 P.H., Advocates for the petitioner, Government Pleader, Additional
 Director General Of Prosecution and of Sri. K.V. Sohan, State Attorney for
 R1, R2 and R3, the court passed the following:
 Order
Interim order is extended by one month.

Sd/- V.G.ARUN, JUDGE 22-12-2022 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Tom Jacob vs State Of Kerala on 22 December, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29147390/
